author: reek
body: The fact-sync verb, carried over the trust wire. A holds h1 and h2, B holds h2 and h3. A offers every hash it holds; the offer is encoded to a tagged frame body and decoded back, exactly as TrustTransport would put it on TCP; B answers with the facts A did not name (just h3); that reply crosses the same wire and A absorbs it. After one round A holds all three, and the reply carried exactly the one fact A was missing.

author: reek
body: A message, encoded to (tag, body) bytes and decoded back -- the round trip every AgentMessage makes across TrustTransport.
